comment: Read from src/Onceler.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. The count begins at -1 (Onceler.cpp:26) and is incremented once per chop, so a row set to 4 needs five chops before its gate opens; neither the panel nor the README says so. The Cuts and Wait values are only pushed into the counter when a chop arrives or the count is zero (Onceler.cpp:317), so turning either knob does nothing until the next chop. The Redo jacks have no threshold: Onceler.cpp:297 to 300 hand the raw voltage to a BooleanTrigger, so any non-zero value resets, negative included. The Speak and Talk jacks carry whatever is patched into Speak, so they are given no family. The panel prints Redo where the hover texts read Re-don't and ReDon't, and the mode button is printed as O/L/R with no expansion anywhere. The panel-theme submenu is plugin-wide and cosmetic, so it has no line.
